duration: TAG meets once a month for two hours at rotating library locations
pay_detail: Unpaid. TAG members take part in service projects.
name: Teen Volunteers and Teen Advisory Group (TAG)
what_you_do: Volunteer at the library. Or join TAG, a monthly group. Teens work with teen librarians on events, books, games and teen spaces.
who_can_apply: Volunteers must be in grade 6 or above. You do not need a Naperville library card. TAG is open to teens in grades 6 through 12.
deadline_text: No deadline stated on the page.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online Teen Volunteer Application. For TAG, say you are interested on the application and send the TAG form at the end. Staff review your application.
notes: The volunteer coordinator's phone on the page is 630-637-2226.
